text:
irene: Hey infra, onboarding customer 'acme-ml' is blocked by Azure quota + subnet size when provisioning ND/NC SKUs in westeurope. Subscription ID 8f3a-xxxx. We need ND40rs x6, NC24rs x4, NCv3 x8. Also need regional core quota bumped to 2048. I already opened an Azure SR: 12023456 — can someone take the handoff with MS?

cloud-support: Thanks @irene — SR 12023456 created and assigned. Escalating to capacity team now. Link: https://aka.ms/azsupport/12023456 (internal view)

sam: I can own the Azure side. Quick question: do we want a quota bump only or a capacity reservation? If this is production we should request reserved capacity for ND40rs to avoid stockouts. Ballpark monthly commit for 6 ND40rs is ~ $28k. @alex can you confirm peak concurrency?

alex: Workload is real-time inference for their product — peak needs 6 ND40rs simultaneously, but can roll out gradually. Preference is reserved capacity for guaranteed availability. Also networking: current prod vnet is /24 which is too small. We'll need a new /22 or peered vnet.

irene: Networking failure details: AKS nodepool creation failed with CIDR error: `Error creating node pool: subnet value /24 too small for requested nodes`. Opened infra ticket INF-3421 for the VNet change.

sam: Plan: 1) escalate SR 12023456 -> capacity PM 2) request subscription-level core increase to 2048 for westeurope 3) open separate capacity reservation order for ND40rs x6 4) coordinate with networking on /22. I'll take steps 1-3, assigning @alex for the VNet work.

alex: I'll handle the VNet. Need subscription GUID + tenant ID in private. Also note: ND40rs availability in westeurope is limited right now — recommend opening eastus2 as backup region for immediate capacity. I'll reach out to our Azure partner rep.

cloud-support: Update on SR 12023456: escalated to Capacity PM, ETA for response 48 hours. If you want a reservation order, open a sales request and reference this SR.

irene: FYI finance gave a cost estimate: reserved ND40rs x6 ~ $28k/month. Spot would be ~60% cheaper but preemptible. For customer SLA we should reserve at least 4 and use spot/NC for burst.

sam: For immediate unblock we can authorize NCv3/NC24rs for lower-priority work while ND reservation is being processed. I'll prepare SR notes with exact SKU counts and justification.

alex: Command we used to verify current usage: `az vm list-usage -l westeurope --subscription 8f3a-xxxx` shows core limit 1024, currentValue 1016. We need to request an increase to 2048.

irene: Pasting relevant snippet: ```{ "name": "standardNDCores", "limit": 1024, "currentValue": 1016 }```

sam: I'll ping our Azure rep and update the SR with the go-live date and counts. @irene please add go-live ETA in the portal note so MS prioritizes.

irene: Done — added go-live 2026-04-15 and flagged 'production' impact. Linked INF-3421.

alex: Created a fallback plan: spin up eastus2 NDv4 spot nodes and replicate minimal model artifacts to them. Scripted failover runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nd-capacity-fallback.

infra-bot: SR 12023456 status changed -> "Escalated to Capacity PM" (by cloud-support)

sam: I'll follow up in 24h. If no progress, I'll escalate to Azure sales rep and request a formal capacity reservation quote. Closing the loop once reservation order or quota increase is confirmed. :thumbsup:
